National Make A Difference Day is an annual day of community service dedicated to improving the lives of others through volunteering, acts of kindness, and positive contributions. National Make A Difference Day is observed on the fourth Saturday of October each year.
It was started in 1992 by USA WEEKEND magazine and is now supported by various humanitarian and volunteer organizations.
The day was created to inspire people to take action and demonstrate that everyone can have an impact, no matter how big or small their effort.

The aim is to encourage volunteering and foster a sense of community, empathy, and social responsibility. Activities can range from cleaning up public spaces, helping neighbors, organizing donation drives, supporting schools, to any act that helps others.
Individuals, families, schools, businesses, and organizations participate by organizing or joining service projects. It's a chance tor anyone to find a way to make a positive difference-locally, nationally, or even globally.
